changes: Ordinary focus retains all loaded own pages and independent per-tab scroll positions; explicit pull refresh resets the own-page window.
Own pagination follows the last scanned raw row, preserving PostgreSQL timestamp precision and UUID tie-breaking independently of pins and collaborations.

A single scoped 25-second operation pins the initiating JWT for metadata and later media capabilities, limits retained hydration to two concurrent 100-ID requests, and stops subsequent batches on cancellation or session change.
Every tab removes rows no longer present in successful authorized metadata before signing; a signing outage preserves authorized existing previews and exposes retry.
Synchronous pagination locks and request/session generations prevent duplicate pages, late decoration truncation, blurred callbacks and A-to-B-to-A responses.
Header, optional reach and story indicator use bounded scoped reads; prefetch completion is checked before dispatch and focus cleanup aborts requests.

Generally readable collaborator posts are excluded from the primary retained own-post window; only a currently accepted collaboration link can add them back, including when the optional membership read fails.
coverage: Actual compiled profile service and extracted production screen callbacks with synthetic transport, including the shared private-media authorization/signing helper.
Per-tab ScrollView offset and before-paint restoration callback behavior; not an emulator or physical-device timing measurement.
limits: The Auth SDK getUser transport has no AbortSignal argument; the outer deadline rejects the UI operation and prevents later dispatch/updates even if an underlying Auth transport settles later.
Full bundled native UI and deployed browser timing remain separate acceptance evidence.
